Title: Highfield Therapy
Welcome: Welcome to Highfield Therapy. I offer warm, confidential, professional therapy to help you navigate life's challenges — online, or in person here in Sheffield.
About: My name is Robert. I offer integrative, relational psychotherapy with a focus on Transactional Analysis (TA), and a special interest in relational trauma and deep-rooted emotional difficulties — a safe, confidential space for profound and lasting healing. I welcome all individuals, regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation or background. I believe that while emotional wounds are formed in relationship, they are also healed within a secure, trustworthy therapeutic relationship, and my work is grounded in cultural humility: I see healing as connected not only to the individual but to family, community and culture, and I stay mindful of how wider social pressures shape our wellbeing. I hold professional diplomas in counselling, am a member of the UK Association for Transactional Analysis (UKATA), and am studying toward an MSc in Transactional Analysis. Alongside more than 15 years' experience in education, I've supported people through trauma, bereavement and crisis — including work with a charity supporting survivors of trafficking and modern slavery, with Cruse and with Samaritans. I'm a committed ally, and I prioritise an affirming, non-judgemental space for clients from LGBQ+ and Trans communities.
Therapy: I work in an integrative, trauma-informed way, with a focus on Transactional Analysis (TA). Rather than following a single rigid method, I tailor our work gently and safely to your goals, so you feel grounded and in control. My study of Transactional Analysis helps us understand the relationship patterns you once learned to survive — patterns that may now affect trust, intimacy and self-worth. I offer both open-ended therapy and shorter, more focused work, online or in person from my private Garden Room in Sheffield, a calm space designed to feel like a secure retreat for the deeper work we do together.
Fees: Sessions are £50, and I offer concessions to those on a low or no income. I can arrange a free 15-minute phone consultation to talk about how I can help and answer any questions you may have about therapy, then book an in-person or online appointment.
Contact: I'm based in Sheffield, a 20-minute walk from Sheffield Central station and close to a tram stop, with plenty of free on-street parking. To get in touch, call or message 07946827431, or use the email button below.
